title: Classic British Leek Gratin
description: A simple, comforting British-inspired dish made with tender leeks in a creamy sauce, adapted to a vegan version using plant-based milk and cheese.
instructions: 2. Slice the leeks into 1-inch pieces and separate the layers.
3. In a large saucepan, sauté the leeks in vegan butter until tender.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together plant-based milk, flour, and nutritional yeast.
5. Pour the milk mixture over the leeks and stir until combined.
6. Transfer the leek mixture to a baking dish and top with vegan grated cheese.
7. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
9. Note: You can also make this recipe in individual ramekins for a more elegant presentation.
